γενόμην: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. 1 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐγενόμην): ’I became, I was born’
δαμάσαντες: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having overpowered’
κεῖσο: κεῖμαι — lie; impf. 2 sg., epic (= Attic ἔκεισο): ’you lay’
κλυτοτέχνην: κλυτοτέχνης — famous in craft, skilled craftsman; masc. acc. sg., epithet of Hephaestus
οἰσέμεν: φέρω — carry, bring; epic inf. built on οἰσ- (the stem of fut. οἴσω), usu. classed with the mixed aor. (imper. οἶσε): ’to bring’
παρειάων: παρειή — cheek; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
πολύφρονά: πολύφρων — of many counsels, much-minded; masc. acc. sg., accented before an enclitic
πῆξαι: πήγνυμι — fix, fasten; aor. inf. used as an imperative: ’fix, fasten!’ (or aor. mid. imper. 2 sg., the same form)
σέβας: σέβας — awe, reverent wonder; neut. nom. sg. (σέβας μ’ ἔχει ’awe holds me’)
τεῦ: τίς — who? whose?; interrog. pron., gen. sg., epic (= Attic τίνος)
τράπεθ: τρέπω — turn; aor. imper. 2 pl. act., elided (τράπεθ’ = τράπετε): ’turn (us), send (us)’
υἱεῖ: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic by-form υἱεῖ (= Attic υἱῷ)
φόνος: φόνος — murder, slaughter, bloodshed; masc. nom. sg.
φύγε: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφυγε); + acc.: ’fled from’
ἀέξεται: ἀέξω — increase, cause to grow; mid.-pass. ἀέξομαι, pres. 3 sg.: ’grows’
ἀμφινέμονται: ἀμφινέμομαι — dwell around, inhabit; pres. 3 pl. mid., + acc.
ἀνιόντι: ἄνειμι — go up, rise; pres. part. masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’rising’
ἄγραυλοι: ἄγραυλος — living in the fields, out in the pasture; adj. (2-termination), fem. nom. pl.
ἐκεῖνοι: ἐκεῖνος — that, he; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’those men’ (the Attic form beside epic κεῖνος)
ἐνείκαι: φέρω — bring, carry (aor. stem ἐνεικ-); aor. opt. 3 sg. act. in -αι, epic (= Attic ἐνέγκαι): ’might bring’
ἐφέηκε: ἐφίημι — send upon, set on, impel; aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐπῆκε), gnomic: ’impels’
ἔδυσαν: ἐκδύω — strip off, take off; aor. 3 pl. (transitive: ’they stripped’), ἐκ … ἔδυσαν in tmesis
ἕστηκε: ἵστημι — set, stand; perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense: ’stands’
ἧμαι: ἧμαι — sit, sit still, remain; pres. 1 sg. mid.
ἱκέσθω: ἱκνέομαι — come, reach; aor. imper. mid. 3 sg.: ’let it come’
ὀλέκουσιν: ὀλέκω — destroy, kill; pres. 3 pl. act. with ν-movable: ’destroy’
ὁμοίη: ὅμοιος — like, similar (+ dat.); fem. nom. sg., epic (= ὁμοία)
